_comment: Screen mode's cross-process contract. The desktop shell (desktop/screen-mode.js) names sessions and images and writes events.json; the backend (backend/screen_sessions.py) adopts, serves, keeps and deletes them; the renderer (frontend/src/screen-annotations.ts) reads the manifest. Each side's suite checks its constants against this file, so a rename on one side fails the build instead of silently orphaning screenshots.
_derivedComment: The agent's cheap copies, written beside the originals: a shot's downscaled JPEG (`shot-NN-preview.jpg`, of its first image) and one close-up JPEG per stroke (`shot-NN-n<number>.jpg`, the number drawn beside the stroke). They live, move and are deleted with the screens folder and are served like the originals, but are not screenshots: the history lists only names matching screenshotNamePattern.
_fileNameFormsComment: The file names as the transcript's header states them to its reader, once (frontend/src/screen-annotations.ts): NN is the shot's number (two digits or more), K a stroke's number. Each side's suite checks its own names against these forms.
_manifestComment: version 3. A stroke: `n` is its number on the picture (1, 2, 3… in each shot); `tool` rect|pen; `shape` rect|loop|line|curve|dot (a rectangle one of whose sides is no thicker than the pen's straightness tolerance is a `line`, a `dot` when both are — desktop/screen-mode.js strokeShape); `box` (x, y, w, h) and the centre `xPct`/`yPct` are whole percent (0..100) of the captured area (the shot's `area`: the front window, or the display), the stroke cut to that area; `crop` is the absolute path of its close-up and is absent when none was made. A click (only when the take's "record clicks" setting was on; none otherwise): a plain click that reached the app underneath (never one on Transcriptor's own palette or capsule); `shot` is the screenshot that followed it, absent when none did; `xPct`/`yPct` are its point in whole percent of that shot's captured area, absent when it lay outside it; the screenshot shows a ring there. A shot: `files` are the original PNGs; `preview` is the absolute path of the downscaled copy of files[0], absent when none was made; `area` is window|display. Version 2 manifests (no click events) and version 1 manifests (no n/tool/shape/box/crop/preview/area; xPct/yPct of the whole display) are still read.

manifestV1._comment: What 1.6.x wrote; still read everywhere a manifest is read.

archivedManifest._comment: What the backend adds when it adopts a session beside its recording: the epoch ms of the recording's first audio sample. Marks are placed from this, on every transcript of the recording.
